domainExists.title: Domain exists
domainExists.description: False when DNS confirms NXDOMAIN and no NS/SOA records exist. Null when this could not be determined (e.g. DNS and RDAP both timed out).

dnsTxt.title: TXT records
dnsTxt.description: All TXT records on the apex.

spfRecord.title: SPF record
spfRecord.description: Raw SPF record, or null if absent.

dmarcRecord.title: DMARC record
dmarcRecord.description: Raw DMARC record, or null if absent.

dkimSelectorsFound.title: DKIM selectors found
dkimSelectorsFound.description: Common DKIM selectors that resolved. Always empty when dkimWildcard is true.

dkimWildcard.title: DKIM wildcard detected
dkimWildcard.description: True when this domain's DNS answers ANY _domainkey selector (wildcard) — in that case dkimSelectorsFound is not trustworthy and is left empty.

mailProfile.title: Mail profile
mailProfile.description: "no-mail" (RFC 7505 null MX, or no MX at all, plus a strict non-authorizing SPF — DKIM not required for the grade), "sending" (has a real MX record), or "unknown" (neither signal is conclusive). Null only if DNS lookups failed entirely.

emailSecurityGrade.title: Email security grade
emailSecurityGrade.description: Simple A-F heuristic grade based on SPF/DMARC/DKIM posture — DKIM is not required for a "no-mail" domain. See README for the full rubric.

emailSecurityIssues.title: Email security issues
emailSecurityIssues.description: Human-readable list of issues behind the grade.
example: DMARC policy is p=quarantine — suspicious mail is quarantined, not rejected.

rdapNameServers.title: RDAP name servers
rdapNameServers.description: Name servers per the RDAP record. Registrant personal fields are never read at all (RDAP, not WHOIS).

dorkUrls.title: Dork URLs
dorkUrls.description: Generated Google dork queries and URLs for this domain.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Partial-failure notes (e.g. RDAP lookup failed) when part of the report couldn't be completed.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this domain was checked.
